text.p: nStor Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it completed the purchase of Parity Systems Inc for $8 million.
The purchase price consisted of $5.8 million cash, assumption of $2.2 million of liabilities, plus a warrant to purchase 500,000 shares of nStor Technologies' common stock at $2.10 per share.
The cash portion of the deal included repayment of Parity's $3 million bank line, nStor said.

Parity Systems is an integrator of information storage management solutions, digital media management and client/server systems for RISC-based UNIX and Windows NT Server environments, the company said.

"We currently estimate that nStor Corporation's sales in 1997 should exceed $40 million, following the purchase of assets from Parity Systems Inc," Mark Levy, president of nStor Technologies, said in a statement.
"This will compare with an estimated $15 million plus in sales for nStor Corporation and its predecessor company during the 1996 calendar year."
